metadata.title: What if Light had to explain EVERY name to L?
metadata.description:
A supernatural rule forces Light to defend each proposed notebook entry to L before it can take effect.

Original hypothetical comedy and commentary. Fan-made alternate scenario; events and dialogue are invented, not canon. AI-assisted narration: Kokoro am_michael. Sound effects: actual Vine Boom/faaah/Rizz recordings from the DubbingAI collection; community excerpt reuse rights unverified.
